primary.chain_difference: phase-reweighted Q4 minus Q1 within the same chain
primary.estimate: equal-weight mean of 8 paired chain differences
primary.stderr: sample SD of 8 paired differences divided by sqrt(8)
primary.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t with df=7; chains are independent repeats, blocks are not repeats
primary.small_sample_caveat: t interval assumes approximately normal independent chain differences; eight chains remain a small sample

historical: 7101-7104 and 7201-7204 shown separately; never pooled into primary batch
auxiliary: existing 100/200/400 blocking and diagnostics; no new veto conditions
stop: exactly 8 new chains; no outcome-dependent additions and no T=6.4 in these jobs
